ac_gate.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
		every_in_list = {
			variable = ac_gate_claims
			limit = { has_variable = ac_gate_level }
			save_scope_as = ac_gate_county
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_gate_contenders value = 3 }
			ordered_living_character = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes has_trait = ac_cultivator location ?= { county ?= { ac_same_gate_region_trigger = yes } } }
				order_by = ac_aura_pressure_value
				max = 3
				check_range_bounds = no
				ac_gate_roll_effect = yes
				ac_gate_absorb_effect = yes
			}
			scope:ac_gate_county = { remove_variable = ac_gate_level remove_county_modifier = ac_heavenly_gate_modifier }
		}
		clear_variable_list = ac_gate_claims
	}
}
